text_block_list.text:
This is no biggie!
Don't sweat it! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだまだ、
なんくるないさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
The Majimun still hasn't had enough, either!
But I won't lose!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マジムンもまだまだ
って言ってるよ～
でも私は負けないよ～！
